tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. # Tâche : MM-03.3 — jalon 1, passe 8 (forme des destinations, garantie d'initialisation, bilan de clôture)

## Git
Même branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite. Pas de merge, pas de PR. Tout sous `formal/`. `Ern/MM02.lean` inchangé. Spec jointe : MM-03.3 v0.2, non copiée ; arbitrages A1–A11, B1–B10, C1–C9, D1–D4, F1–F7, G1–G5 en vigueur, sauf ce que J1 remplace ; J1 et J2 font foi.

## Langue
Code, docstrings, commentaires, messages de commit en anglais. Rapport en français.

## Arbitrages (font foi)
J1. Forme des destinations (garantie 3 de la charte).
  - `transfer src dst` : `dst` a la même forme que `src` (sous-arbres isomorphes) ; toutes les feuilles de `src` sont `Init` ; les feuilles de `dst` ne sont pas `Init` (inchangé). Effet : chaque feuille de `dst` := `Init`, chaque feuille de `src` := `Moved` ; une autorité détenue par une partie de `src` passe à la partie correspondante de `dst` ; un emplacement possédé par une partie de `src` passe à la partie correspondante de `dst`, avec sa racine (`RootHeld` préservé). Un agrégat partiellement initialisé se transfère champ par champ.
  - `issue` : la destination est une feuille non `Init` qui ne détient aucune autorité active ; seule cette feuille passe à `Init`.
  - `issue` et `reset` ne changent pas l'initialisation de la valeur arène ; `newArena` exige les feuilles du détenteur de `internal` toutes `Init`.
  - `init_only_by_writes` : pour chaque pas `ok`, une feuille non `Init` avant et `Init` après est couverte par l'écriture de ce pas (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store` sur cette feuille, `issue` vers cette feuille), ou est la feuille de `dst` correspondant à une feuille de `src` `Init` avant le pas (`transfer`). Plus `init_statics` : sur `S3.init`, seules les feuilles statiques déclarées `Init` le sont.
J2. Différé, sans modification du module : `NoLock` (auto-blocage à définir séparément si la règle est retenue), forme forte de F6 (`Reach`, `lineage`, `derivedIn`, G1', A3 strict), justification de `noalias`. `call_params_effective_protected`, G1, G2 et `NoOrphan` restent tels quels.

## Étapes (un commit par étape)
1. J1 : `transfer`, `issue`, `newArena` réécrits ; correspondance des parties pour les autorités détenues et les emplacements possédés ; préservation de `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan ∧ ArenaInv` ; `init_only_by_writes`, `init_statics`.
2. Cas, depuis `S3.init` par des pas de `Reachable`, chaque rejet avec son jumeau positif :
   - `transfer_inits_unwritten`, `transfer_inits_unwritten_after_store`, `issue_inits_unwritten` : rejetés ; jumeau : source entièrement `Init`, destination de même forme → `ok`, lecture `ok` ;
   - transfert d'une structure dont un champ détient une autorité stockée : l'autorité passe au champ correspondant ;
   - transfert d'une valeur possédant un stockage : la possession et la racine passent à la partie correspondante ;
   - transfert champ par champ d'un agrégat partiellement initialisé → `ok` ;
   - tous les cas des passes précédentes rejoués ; tout verdict qui change est listé et justifié.

## Hors périmètre
Tout ce que J2 diffère ; pool de handles ; jalon 2 ; concurrence ; flot de contrôle ; suspension ; `defer` ; obligation de libération ; syntaxe ; corpus MM3-H complet.

## Règles
Zéro `sorry` ; `#print axioms` au plus {propext, Quot.sound} ; aucun `noncomputable` ; `lake build` sans avertissement ; docstrings citant la clause ou l'arbitrage ; rien d'inventé ; aucun énoncé affaibli, tout changement justifié ; revue adverse centrée sur J1 : tout autre chemin vers une feuille `Init` jamais écrite, et tout transfert légal rejeté à tort par la condition de forme ; contre-exemples conservés.

280:def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'
1607:def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ a p, s.I p = .moved → ¬ CanReadLeaf s a p
1612:def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
1616:def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
1621:def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
1627:def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
1690:def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
7023:def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

theorem Inv3.base {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : Inv3base s := h.1
theorem Inv3.ao {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : AnchorOrder s := h.2.1
theorem Inv3.nd {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : NoDangling s := h.2.2

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (C2): no active authority covers a leaf of a place that is not usable in the sense
of `Usable` (existence, `dead` mark, chain of owners). It says nothing of initialisation: a leaf
`Uninit` or `Moved` of a usable place may stay covered. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

theorem noDangling_iff {s : S3} : NoDangling s ↔
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l →
      ∀ q ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l, s.Usable q := by
  constructor
  · intro h j _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l hl hlP hleaf q hq
    have hl' : l ∈ y.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hy] using hl
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => h j y hy ya q hu l
      (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, (List.mem_cons.1 hq).imp Eq.symm id⟩) hl'
  · intro h j y hy ya q hu l hl hly
    obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    exact hu (h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l
      (by simp only [S3.afp, hy]; exact hly) hlP hleaf q (List.mem_cons.2 (hq.imp Eq.symm id)))

/-- I4 holds in every state: the read condition requires `Init` (MM-03.3 §2, I4; §5). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ hm h => by rw [h.2.1] at hm; cases hm

/-- Root place (MM-03.3.2; B1): an existing place without parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- First clause of B1: two distinct root places have disjoint footprints. Parts and their
containing places are not concerned. -/
def RootsDisjoint (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ r r', RootPlace P r → RootPlace P r' → r ≠ r' → ∀ l ∈ footprint P r, l ∉ footprint P r'

/-- Second clause of B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root
authority of the root place of that leaf, an authority without origin whose footprint is the
footprint of that root place. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- A4, "Une racine reste détenue par le propriétaire de son emplacement", a possession condition
that A1 keeps in `WF3`: an authority without origin is held by the owner of the root place of
every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-- `WF3` (A1, A4, B1, C3): well-formedness, the domain of admissible states, separate from the
safety invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing
places; the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`;
owner places exist; a part comes after its parent and has its owner and its `dead` flag; every
active authority has a live holder (possession); B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering
a leaf ends at the root authority of its root place (`RootChain`); A4: a root is held by the owner
of its place (`RootHeld`). C3: the first clause of B1, `RootsDisjoint`, is not a clause: it holds
for every list of places (`rootsDisjoint_always`). -/
def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length) ∧
  s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
    o < s.P.length) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder) ∧
  RootChain s ∧ RootHeld s

/-- The pass-1 exclusivity on effective modes (MM-03.3 §2, I1) is a theorem under the
strengthened I1 (A1). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
      Compat m₁ m₂ := by
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

/-- `effective_exclusive` (MM-03.3 §10): under I1, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf
is the only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- `shared_keeps_exclusivity` (A9): I1 holds on `SharedMutable` leaves like on any other leaf:
two unrelated active authorities covering such a leaf are both in `Observe`. -/
theorem shared_keeps_exclusivity {k : K} {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b : Nat} {x y : Authority}
    {p : Nat} (_hsh : k.SharedMutable p) (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (hy : s.A[b]? = some y) (xa : x.active = true) (ya : y.active = true)
    (xp : p ∈ x.footprint) (yp : p ∈ y.footprint) (hnab : a ∉ s.ancs b) (hnba : b ∉ s.ancs a) :
    x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe :=
  h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba

/-- Central theorem (MM-03.3 §5): in a state satisfying `Inv3base`, an authorised ordinary write
coexists with no other authority with a present effective mode on the written leaves. The proof
uses only the effective `Modify` of the writer. -/
theorem write3_exclusive {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none := by
  intro p hp b hb
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hw⟩, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact effective_exclusive hinv.1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw p hp).1

/-! ## Reused lemmas on chains, additions and skeletons -/

theorem nil_of_forall_not_mem {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a, a ∉ l) → l = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: _, h => absurd (List.mem_cons_self ..) (h a)

/-- In the arrival state of a transfer, a part of the destination has the owner of the
destination (A5, J1): their owners were equal before (`WF3`) and change under the same rule. -/
theorem transfer_owner_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    ∃ pd pr, (transferEff s src dst).P[dst]? = some pd ∧ (transferEff s src dst).P[r']? = some pr ∧
      pr.owner = pd.owner := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pd, hpl, hpd, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
  refine ⟨_, _, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpd]; rfl, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl, ?_⟩
  show (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then _ else pl).owner = (if heldIn s.P src pd.owner then _ else pd).owner
  rw [ho]; split
  · rfl
  · exact ho

/-- A part of the destination is usable after the transfer when the destination is (A5, J1). -/
theorem transfer_usable_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable r' := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact hd'.of_same hpd hpr ho (by show s.dead r' = s.dead dst; exact hw.deadOf hr')

/-- A part of the destination has the frame of the destination after the transfer (A5, J1). -/
theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

/-- `transfer` changes no skeleton: it creates and duplicates no authority (O4.3). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [transfer_A_get]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A place usable after the transfer was usable before (A5). -/

  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl

## 9. Correspondance future avec MM-02

Le raffinement vers MM-02 ne fait pas partie du premier jalon.

Il devra néanmoins établir une relation de représentation entre :

- Les emplacements MM-03 et les emplacements MM-02.
- Les empreintes logiques et les plages de stockage.
- Les autorités effectives et les droits de lecture ou d'écriture.
- Les dépendances actives et la validité temporelle.
- Les états d'initialisation et les représentations mémoire valides.

Les obligations de raffinement sont :

**R1 — Lecture :** une lecture sûre de MM-03 satisfait les préconditions applicables de MM-02.

**R2 — Écriture :** une écriture sûre de MM-03 satisfait les préconditions applicables de MM-02.

**R3 — Préservation :** les transitions sûres préservent les invariants de la discipline d'accès.

**R4 — Invalidation :** aucun accès sûr encore utilisable ne désigne un stockage invalidé.

**R5 — Conservation :** aucune opération sûre ne duplique un droit exclusif incompatible.

**R6 — Raffinement :** chaque effet concret produit par une transition sûre correspond à une transition autorisée de MM-02.

La démonstration de R1, R2, R4 et R6 constitue un jalon distinct après stabilisation du noyau MM-03.

## 10. Théorèmes du premier jalon

Le premier jalon doit viser :

- `derive_preserves_exclusivity`
- `split_preserves_exclusivity`
- `effective_exclusive`
- `release_restores_authority`
- `transfer_no_duplicate_authority`
- `transfer_invalidates_source`
- `depend_preserves_anchor_validity`
- `dependent_cannot_escape_frame`
- `exitFrame_releases_all`
- `arena_issue_preserves_disjointness`
- `arena_issue_keeps_earlier_blocks`
- `arena_reset_rejects_live_dependents`
- `reachable_access_invariant`

Les noms sont indicatifs.

Une preuve qui réénonce directement une précondition comme conclusion ne constitue pas, à elle seule, une validation suffisante du mécanisme.

Les théorèmes doivent notamment établir la préservation des invariants par les transitions successives et les propriétés non triviales des autorités effectives.

/-- The witness state of `transfer_not_inv3_preserving` in passes 4 to 7: the same without the
places 4 and 5, the destination 3 being a leaf. -/
def xferCex7 : S3 := ⟨[1, 0], 6, [⟨some 1, .frame 1, 0⟩, ⟨some 0, .frame 5, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 1, 0⟩,
  ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩], fun _ => .uninit,
  [⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 1, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [], .frame 1, false⟩],
  fun q => if q = 2 then [1] else [], fun _ => false, fun _ => false, fun _ => false, [], fun _ => []⟩

/-- J1 rejects the transfer of `transfer_not_inv3_preserving` in passes 4 to 7: the source, through
its parent links that `chain` ignores, has no shape the leaf 3 matches (`¬ SameShape`); its effect
would still break `I3`. -/
theorem transfer_not_inv3_preserving_p7_rejected :
    Inv3 xferCex7 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 xferCex7 .reject ∧ ¬ SameShape xferCex7.P 0 3 ∧

=== transfer_not_inv3_preserving
/-- `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A5; J1) does not preserve `Inv3` without `WF3` (A1; C2): a part
with another owner than its parent (excluded by `WF3`) is not usable while its parent is; a place
owned by that part is not usable either and keeps an invalid anchor. The transfer gives that place
to the part 5 of the destination that corresponds to the part 1 (J1), where it becomes usable with
an invalid anchor. The witness of passes 4 to 7, without the parts 4 and 5, is rejected by J1

theorem transfer_not_inv3_preserving :
    Inv3 xferCex ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 xferCex (.ok (transferEff xferCex 0 3)) ∧

/-- J1: the arena value is written before `newArena`. -/
def it1w : S3 := write3Eff it1 [0]
def it2 : S3 := newArenaEff it1w 5 3
def arIt : Arena := ⟨5, 3, [6], []⟩
def it3 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff it2 arIt [6] 3).1 0 (issueEff it2 arIt [6] 3).2
theorem issue_inits_unwritten :
    Reachable K0 [] it3 ∧ NewArenaStep 5 3 it1 .reject ∧ IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 2 it2 .reject ∧

      Read3Step 2 [3] it3 (.ok it3) ∧ Read3Step 2 [4] it3 .reject ∧ it3.I 0 = it2.I 0 ∧

=== transfer_inits_unwritten
/-- The same without `store` (MM-03.3 §3, O4.2; MM-03.3.3; J1): frame 1 has the leaf 0, the
structure 1 with the fields 2 and 3, and the structure 4 with the fields 5 and 6. The frame writes
0; its transfer into 1, which made the field 3, never written, `Init` in pass 7, is rejected (J1,
shape), and 3 stays unreadable. Twin: the frame writes the fields 2 and 3 and transfers 1 into 4, of
the same shape: accepted, and the field 6 is read. -/
def vt0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
def vt1 : S3 := write3Eff vt0 [0]
def vt2 : S3 := write3Eff vt1 [2, 3]
def vt3 : S3 := transferEff vt2 1 4
theorem transfer_inits_unwritten :
    Reachable K0 [] vt3 ∧ vt1.I 3 = .uninit ∧ TransferStep K0 0 1 vt1 .reject ∧
      ¬ SameShape vt1.P 0 1 ∧ Read3Step 1 [3] vt1 .reject ∧
      TransferStep K0 1 4 vt2 (.ok vt3) ∧ Read3Step 2 [6] vt3 (.ok vt3) := by
=== transfer_inits_unwritten_after_store
/-- Pass 7 reached, through `transfer`, the configuration G2 rejects for `store`: a reference held
by a whole structure, whose `length` field becomes `Init` without a write. J1 rejects that
transfer: the destination has another shape than the source. Frame 1: structure 0 with the fields
1 (`ptr`) and 2 (`length`), the buffer 3, the leaves 4 and 5. The frame derives 4, `Modify` on 3,
and stores it into the leaf 4. The transfer of 4 into the structure 0 is rejected (J1, shape).
Twin: the transfer of 4 into the leaf 5, of the same shape, is accepted, 4 passing to 5, which is
then read. -/
def tw0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def tw1 : S3 := deriveEff tw0 1 3 .modify
def tw2 : S3 := storeEff tw1 4 4
def tw3 : S3 := transferEff tw2 4 5
theorem transfer_inits_unwritten_after_store :
    Reachable K0 [] tw2 ∧ StoreStep 4 0 tw1 .reject ∧ TransferStep K0 4 0 tw2 .reject ∧
      ¬ SameShape tw2.P 4 0 ∧ tw2.I 2 = .uninit ∧
      TransferStep K0 4 5 tw2 (.ok tw3) ∧ (tw3.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) ∧
      Read3Step 3 [5] tw3 (.ok tw3) := by

=== transfer_shape_ordered
/-- J1, « sous-arbres isomorphes », read as an ordered isomorphism (`SameShape`: children matched
in index order); a question of the pass-8 report. Frame 1: structure 0 with the leaf 1 and the
structure 2 of fields 3 and 4; structure 5 with the structure 6 of fields 7 and 8, then the leaf 9;
structure 10 with the leaf 11 and the structure 12 of fields 13 and 14. The frame writes the leaves
of 0. The transfer of 0 into 5, isomorphic as unordered trees only, is rejected, by the shape
clause alone; into 10 (twin), accepted. Field by field, 1 into 9 and 2 into 6 have the same
shape. -/
def sq0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),
  (some 2, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 6, none, 0), (some 6, none, 0),
  (some 5, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 10, none, 0), (some 10, none, 0), (some 12, none, 0),
  (some 12, none, 0)]
def sq1 : S3 := write3Eff sq0 [1, 3, 4]
theorem transfer_shape_ordered :
    Reachable K0 [] sq1 ∧ kids sq1.P 0 = [1, 2] ∧ kids sq1.P 5 = [6, 9] ∧
      ¬ SameShape sq1.P 0 5 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 5 sq1 .reject ∧
      (SameShape sq1.P 0 5 → TransferPre K0 sq1 0 5) ∧
      TransferStep K0 0 10 sq1 (.ok (transferEff sq1 0 10)) ∧
      SameShape sq1.P 1 9 ∧ SameShape sq1.P 2 6 := by
=== transfer_field_by_field
/-- J1: a partly initialised aggregate moves field by field. Frame 1: structure 0 with the fields 1
and 2, structure 3 with the fields 4 and 5; only the field 1 is written. The transfer of 0 into 3 is
rejected (the field 2 is not `Init`, O4.1); the transfer of the field 1 into the field 4 is accepted,
after which 4 is read and 5 is not. -/
def pf0 : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)]) [1]
def pf1 : S3 := transferEff pf0 1 4
theorem transfer_field_by_field :
    Reachable K0 [] pf1 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 pf0 .reject ∧ SameShape pf0.P 0 3 ∧
      TransferStep K0 1 4 pf0 (.ok pf1) ∧ Read3Step 1 [4] pf1 (.ok pf1) ∧
      Read3Step 1 [5] pf1 .reject := by
=== transfer_owned_storage_follows
/-- J1: the transfer of a value that owns storage moves the ownership and the root to the
corresponding part of the destination (A5; `RootHeld`). Frame 1: structure 0 with the field 1,
which owns the place 2 (root 1, held by 1); structure 3 with the field 4. The frame writes the field
1 and transfers 0 into 3: the place 2 is now owned by the field 4, its root is held by 4, and it
stays usable. -/
def ts0 : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, some 1, 0),
  (none, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)]) [1]
def ts1 : S3 := transferEff ts0 0 3
theorem transfer_owned_storage_follows :
    Reachable K0 [] ts1 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 ts0 (.ok ts1) ∧
      (ts0.P[2]?).map (·.owner) = some (.place 1) ∧ (ts0.A[1]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 1) ∧
      (ts1.P[2]?).map (·.owner) = some (.place 4) ∧ (ts1.A[1]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) ∧
      ts1.Usable 2 ∧ ts1.I 4 = .init ∧ ts1.I 1 = .moved := by
=== transfer_field_authority_follows
/-- J1: the transfer of a structure whose field holds a stored authority moves that authority to the
corresponding field of the destination. In `fw3`, the view 5 is held by the field 3 of the structure
2; after the transfer of 2 into the structure 4, it is held by the field 5 of 4. -/
theorem transfer_field_authority_follows :
    TransferStep K0 2 4 fw3 (.ok (transferEff fw3 2 4)) ∧ corr fw3.P 2 4 3 = some 5 ∧
      (fw3.A[5]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 3) ∧
      ((transferEff fw3 2 4).A[5]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) :=
=== held_unexercisable_by_transfer
/-- `NoOrphan` (G3) holds on every reached state, but it does not make a held authority
exercisable: `transfer` builds an active authority held by the place it covers, which no frame
can exercise. Frame 1: structure 0 with the field 1, structure 2 with the field 3; roots 0 (on 1)
and 1 (on 3). The frame derives 2, `Modify` on 3, stores it into the field 1 (`ok`), then transfers
0 into 2 (`ok`): by J1, 2 passes to the corresponding field 3, which it covers. Its origin, the root
1, has no effective mode on 3, so 2 is exercisable at no mode, the frame has no `Modify` on the
structure 2 nor on its field 3, and `release` of 2 and `endUse` of 2 are rejected; the exit of
frame 1 releases 2. The chain of G3 is the root 1, held by frame 1, then 2. Pass 7 transferred into
a leaf, which J1 rejects (shape). -/
def hu0 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (some 2, none, 0)]) 1 2 .modify) 2 1
def hu1 : S3 := transferEff hu0 0 2
theorem held_unexercisable_by_transfer :
    Reachable K0 [] hu1 ∧ (hu1.A[2]?).map (fun y => (y.active, y.holder, y.footprint)) =
      some (true, .place 3, [3]) ∧ ¬ hu1.ExercisableAt 2 .observe ∧ ¬ HasRight hu1 .modify 2 ∧
      ¬ HasRight hu1 .modify 3 ∧
      ReleaseStep 2 hu1 .reject ∧ EndUseStep K0 2 hu1 .reject ∧ NoOrphan hu1 ∧
      ExitStep K0 hu1 (.ok (exitEff hu1)) ∧ ¬ (exitEff hu1).Active 2 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 hu1 := by

8574:def WrittenBy (k : K) (s s' : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=

/-- One step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10; D3; F4): a kernel step or an arena step. -/
inductive Step (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' → Step k s s'
  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} : ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Step k s s'

/-- J1: the step from `s` to `s'` writes the leaf `l`: a `write3` or a `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, a `store` into `l`, an `issue` to `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a leaf of the
destination corresponding to a leaf of the source `Init` before the step. -/
def WrittenBy (k : K) (s s' : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ a ls, Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a ls, WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a, StoreStep a l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ i via region, IssueAt k i via region l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ src dst l', TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
    l' ∈ footprint s.P src ∧ corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init)

/-- `init_only_by_writes` (J1): in every `ok` step, a leaf that is not `Init` before and is

  | n + 1, r, r', hr, h => by
    by_cases e : r = src
    · subst e; rw [corr_src] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hd, .inl rfl⟩
    cases hp : parentOf s.P r with
    | none =>
      unfold corr at h
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [corrF, e] at h
      | succ m => simp [corrF, e, hp] at h
    | some p =>
      have hlt := (hw.parent_lt hp).1
      rw [corr_step e hp hlt] at h
      cases hc : corr s.P src dst p with
      | none => rw [hc] at h; cases h
      | some p' =>
        rw [hc] at h; simp only [Option.bind_some] at h
        have ih := corr_partOf hw hd n p p' (by omega) hc
        obtain ⟨hr'l, hr'p⟩ := mem_kids.1 (getElem?_mem h)
        have hlt' := (hw.parent_lt hr'p).1
        refine ⟨hr'l, .inr ?_⟩
        rw [chain_cons hr'p hlt']
        rcases ih.2 with rfl | hc'
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc'

/-- A holder within the source moves to a part of the destination (J1, A4, A5). -/
theorem mvTo_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) {h : Holder}
    (hh : heldIn s.P src h) : ∃ r', mvTo s.P src dst h = .place r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hh.elim
  | place r =>
    cases hc : corr s.P src dst r with
    | none => exact ⟨dst, by simp [mvTo, hc], hd, .inl rfl⟩
    | some r' =>
      exact ⟨r', by simp [mvTo, hc], corr_partOf hw hd (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc⟩

theorem mvTo_place {P : List Place} {src dst : Nat} {h : Holder} (hh : heldIn P src h) :
    ∃ r', mvTo P src dst h = .place r' := by
  cases h with
  | frame _ => exact hh.elim
  | place r => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- Places with the same owner have the same frame (A5). -/
theorem pframe_eq_of_owner {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : s.P[q]? = some pq)
    (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (h : pr.owner = pq.owner) : s.pframe r = s.pframe q := by
  simp only [S3.pframe, pframeF, hq, hr, h]

disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; G4: `reject` when the arrival state,
where the block is held by `dst`, breaks `AnchorOrderHeld`; `ok` otherwise. A failed `issue`
creates no holding relation and has no arrival state, so G4 is not checked before `fail`. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noAnchor : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

content.content:
/-- Anchors of the places whose frame changes when the value at `src` is transferred (A5;
MM-03.3.6): `src`, its parts, and the usable places it owns, transitively. An anchor of a dead
owned place is not read: no usable place depends on it (MM-03.3.6). -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedWithin s src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source (F5:
the footprints of source and destination are disjoint, the clause `¬ overlap`, redundant with
clauses 1 and 2 by `transfer_overlap_redundant`),
and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
on the source and on the destination (B2); 4 no active derived
access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, the whole predicate, for every held
authority; J1: the destination has the shape of the source (`SameShape`). O4.3 holds by
construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

It holds whatever the other 14 clauses of TransferPre are, so it does not show they hold. AGENTS.md calls a statement that holds because its hypothesis cannot be met blocking. The 'shape alone' claim turns out to be true (checked below), but the module does not prove it; the only evidence offered is this vacuous conjunct. findings.evidence: Scratch file p8ver2/vac.lean compiles: `example : (SameShape zo3.P 0 5 → False) := by decide`, and the same for `sq1.P 0 5` and `fwP.P 2 4`.
